# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-118#export-a-note-with-recent-quiz-questions

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-118-export-recent-quiz-questions.md#export-a-note-with-recent-quiz-questions` at `b50fa2911892fbcdfd2cd8b37b412c15265aa128`.
- **Promise:** With inclusion selected, exported Markdown includes up to ten newest distinct focus-note multiple-choice questions ordered by question creation time descending, then question ID descending (key example: twelve questions; equal creation times break ties by descending ID).
- **Fault:** In `backend/src/main/java/com/odde/donut/controllers/NoteExportController.java`, after `findTop10ByNote_IdOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc`, inserted `java.util.Collections.reverse(questions)` so the appendix rendered the selected ten in ascending order. Fixture and assertion stayed unchanged.
- **Existing protection:** `NoteExportControllerAiContextMarkdownTests$RecentQuestionsAppendix.newestTenByCreationThenIdIgnoresInsertionOrderAndIncludesEqualTimestampTies` builds twelve MCQs with deliberately non-insertion chronology and equal-timestamp ties, then asserts `stringContainsInOrder` for stems `1. newest-first` … `10. mid-01` at line 143 and that the two oldest stems are absent.
- **Observed path:** Passing baseline selected exactly that one test (JUnit testcase 0.265 s; Gradle BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 34 s). With the fault, the same test reached line 143 and failed: expected newest-first … mid-01 in order, received mid-01 … newest-first. After restoration, `git checkout --` of the controller, `git diff --exit-code`, and byte comparison against the execution checkout confirmed original tracked state; the identical focused command passed again (JUnit testcase 0.238 s; Gradle BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 36 s). This confirms the intended newest-ten order changed and the maintained assertion caught it.
- **Isolation and restoration:** Used detached scratch worktree `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-118-FQWmMG` at the exact revision, prepared with `./scripts/run.sh bash scripts/worktree_setup.sh`, and isolated DB `doughnut_wt_7d2eddb48f354557ab3bb93b0b49e5a6_test`. An EXIT trap restored the controller; the scratch was removed with `git worktree remove --force` after the restored pass. The execution checkout remained at `b50fa2911892fbcdfd2cd8b37b412c15265aa128` with a clean porcelain status.
- **Command for all three observations:** `./scripts/run.sh pnpm backend:test:worktree --tests 'com.odde.donut.controllers.NoteExportControllerAiContextMarkdownTests$RecentQuestionsAppendix.newestTenByCreationThenIdIgnoresInsertionOrderAndIncludesEqualTimestampTies'` (with `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL`, `DB_URL`, and `SPRING_FLYWAY_URL` unset).

Costs:

- **Test runtime:** Measured Gradle wall times baseline 34 s, fault 34 s, restored 36 s (104 s combined). JUnit XML testcase times: baseline 0.265 s and restored 0.238 s; suite times 9.832 s and 9.524 s. Fault-run JUnit XML timing is unavailable because the restored run overwrote `backend/build/test-results/test/` before that file was copied.
- **Human effort:** Unavailable; no separate human-time measurement was supplied.
- **Agent effort:** Unavailable; the host exposed no independent agent-effort measure.



- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 182767 ms (measured), from 1794300558276 to 1794300741043 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
